panels.description: Roman spreads Nexus chemical and waste records across a dry floor section. One sheet bears the second half of Orien's code; a sealed Merritt file remains unopened at the edge. Leave upper-left clear.
Sitara places Falcon's vibration record beside the Nexus sheet. The codes join with matching minute and coordinate. Leave top clear.
Nayah holds the route tablet while a restrained overlay connects Falcon drilling, ice motion, Nexus process waste, and dead-krill data. Do not reveal Merritt contents. Leave upper third clear.
Sitara and Roman deliberately exchange selected archives through the local mesh. Their physically separate TJs display selected synchronization and unavailable full partitions. Leave top-left clear.
